title: Item/Block Convert+
description:
A converter for items and blocks to create more items from Glanz. 
It's well-suited for SkyBlock or OneBlock to obtain more resources.
body:
This mod adds a powerful converter system that allows you to generate more items and blocks using a special resource called Glanz. It is especially useful for SkyBlock and OneBlock worlds where resources are limited.

The mod introduces a Converter Block, which can transform items into other valuable materials using Glanz. There are three tiers of Glanz:

- Glanz
- Super Glanz
- Mega Glanz

Each tier is craftable and increases in strength and efficiency.

With Mega Glanz, you can significantly multiply your resources. For example, combining one ingot with a Mega Glanz in the crafting table can produce a full block of that material. This works with resources such as iron, gold, diamonds, netherite, and more.

This system makes it much easier to progress in resource-limited environments by allowing players to expand their materials in a balanced and scalable way.

Perfect for players who enjoy SkyBlock or OneBlock and want more progression possibilities without breaking the gameplay balance.
